# Corbel Designs

> Premier Interior Architecture & Turnkey Fit-Out Contracting firm based in Mumbai, India. Led by Imran Khan, Corbel Designs specializes in bespoke luxury residential spaces and fast-track commercial corporate fit-outs with single-point civil and MEP accountability.

- **Company Name**: Corbel Designs[cite: 1]

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Turnkey Contracting (Design-and-Build)**: Single-point execution encompassing civil modifications, structural masonry, plumbing, electrical conduit isolation, HVAC routing, false ceilings, and deep-cleaning snag handover[cite: 1].
- **Interior Architecture & Spatial Design**: 2D floor plans, 3D photorealistic visualization, space planning, lighting design, and material palette selection[cite: 1].
- **Custom Modular Joinery & Millwork**: Factory-assembled cabinetry using PUR hot-press edge banding, BWP marine ply, and high-performance hardware[cite: 1].
- **Commercial & Corporate Fit-Outs**: Acoustic meeting spaces, open-plan workstations, server rooms, and rapid 30-to-45-day execution schedules[cite: 1].

## Technical Engineering Standards & Material Chain
- **Core Woodwork**: Exclusively IS-710 BWP (Boiling Water Proof) calibrated marine ply from Greenlam/Greenply[cite: 1].
- **Fittings & Hardware**: Häfele architectural systems and Blum Austria Servo-Drive/soft-close mechanisms[cite: 1].
- **Glazing & Acoustic Partitions**: Saint-Gobain acoustic, low-iron, and toughened safety glass[cite: 1].
- **Electrical & Smart Automation**: Legrand Arteor modular switches, fire-retardant ISI-grade cabling, and Megger load isolation testing[cite: 1].
- **Finishes & Coatings**: Asian Paints Royale zero-VOC luxury emulsions and PU matt/gloss veneer polishes[cite: 1].
- **Waterproofing Protocol**: 3-tier polyurethane waterproofing with 48 to 72-hour pond testing for wet areas and decks[cite: 1].

## Geographic Coverage & Micro-Markets
- **Powai & Chandivali (HQ)**: Hiranandani Gardens, Raheja Vistas, Lake Homes, and Boomerang commercial fit-outs[cite: 1].
- **Bandra & Khar**: Sea-facing luxury duplexes, Pali Hill apartments, and coastal-grade moisture-resilient fit-outs[cite: 1].
- **Worli & Lower Parel**: Ultra-luxury skyscraper apartments, sky lounges, and automation-rich layouts[cite: 1].
- **Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC)**: Grade-A corporate offices, venture capital suites, and fast-track commercial fit-outs[cite: 1].
- **Extended Regions**: Thane (Hiranandani Estate), Navi Mumbai (Palm Beach Road), Pune (Koregaon Park, Baner), and Goa (Assagao, Anjuna holiday villas)[cite: 1].
